statsFunctions.block: function v536SeasonGA(id){let goals=0,assists=0,found=false;for(const rows of Object.values(state?.competitionStats||{})){const r=rows?.[id];if(!r)continue;found=true;goals+=Number(r.goals)||0;assists+=Number(r.assists)||0;}if(!found){const p=state?E.player(state,id):null;goals=Number(p?.goals)||0;assists=Number(p?.assists)||0;}return {goals,assists};}

statsFunctions.block: function v538LegacyRows(pid){const out=[];for(const a of state.scorerArchive||[]){if(state.v538CareerArchive?.[a.year])continue;let goals=0,assists=0,clubs={};for(const rows of Object.values(a.competitions||{})){const r=rows?.[pid];if(!r)continue;goals+=Number(r.goals)||0;assists+=Number(r.assists)||0;Object.assign(clubs,r.clubs||{});}if(!goals&&!assists)continue;const ids=Object.keys(clubs);if(ids.length===1)out.push({year:a.year,teamId:ids[0],teamName:clubs[ids[0]],goals,assists,yellow:null,red:null,legacy:true,clubIds:ids});else out.push({year:a.year,teamId:null,teamName:ids.length?Object.values(clubs).join(' / '):'Clube não registrado',goals,assists,yellow:null,red:null,legacy:true,clubIds:ids});}return out;}
